professional_summary: Business intelligence leader with 5+ years of progressive experience owning enterprise analytics strategy, building scalable data platforms, and transforming raw operational data into the intelligence that drives organizational decisions. At Austal USA, I've operated as the de facto BI Director for a $2B+ defense shipbuilding program - setting the analytics vision, designing the governance framework, establishing data standards across six departments, and personally delivering the platforms that moved the organization from manual reporting to real-time intelligence. I've cut reporting cycle times by 35%, reduced material waste by 30%, and built a BI infrastructure that processes 2M+ records daily with sub-2-second latency. I'm a technical leader who speaks the language of both engineers and executives - and I'm looking for a Director-level role where I can build and lead a team, own the analytics roadmap, and make data a genuine organizational competitive advantage.

Delivered a real-time BI platform that transformed how Austal leadership consumes operational data - replacing fragmented manual reports with live Power BI dashboards, cutting reporting cycle time by 35% and enabling same-day data-driven responses to production issues.

Drove a 30% reduction in material waste and 22% improvement in assembly line uptime through analytics-driven insights, directly contributing to program performance on a multi-billion dollar Navy contract.

Serve as the executive-facing analytics leader - translating complex engineering and production data into strategic insights for program managers, operations directors, and C-suite stakeholders, shaping planning decisions that involve multi-million dollar resource allocations.
Informally lead and mentor junior analysts and developers - establishing technical standards, conducting design reviews, and building the team's capability to deliver analytics independently.

Champion data-driven culture change across the organization - building business cases for analytics investments, securing cross-functional buy-in from skeptical stakeholders, and demonstrating ROI through measurable operational outcomes.
